titleEn: FIRA USA Expands Women in Agricultural Innovation Award for 2026, Broadening Beyond Robotics to Honor Trailblazers Across AgTech
titleZh: FIRA USA 2026将农业创新女性奖扩展至AgTech全领域
summaryZh: FIRA USA宣布将其2025年设立的“农业机器人女性年度奖”扩展并更名为“农业创新女性奖”（WiAI），2026年评选范围从机器人扩展至精准农业、数据与AI、生物技术、传感器、软件、灌溉等AgTech全领域。提名现已开放，截止日期为10月5日，获奖者将在FIRA USA 2026（10月20-22日，华盛顿州亚基马）接受表彰。该奖项旨在提升女性在农业科技领域的可见度，激励更多女性进入并引领AgTech生态。
featuredReason: 该新闻反映了AgTech领域对女性领导力的日益重视，奖项从机器人扩展至AI、数据、传感器等全领域，与智慧畜牧行业关注的自动化、AI和传感器技术趋势一致，值得行业人士关注以了解国际AgTech生态发展和多元化趋势。
contentFull:
By GOFAR 

 

 Share

 

 

 

 

 

 Arha Padman of Niqo Robotics (2nd from the right), recipient of the inaugural 2025 Women in AgRobotics of the Year Award, is recognized on stage at FIRA USA 2025. The award, now expanded and renamed the Women in Agricultural Innovation Award, celebrates women advancing agriculture’s future through AgTech.

 Nominations are now open for the second annual Women in Agricultural Innovation Award (WiAI), as FIRA USA broadens its recognition of female leaders across agriculture’s innovation landscape. Applications are due Oct. 5, with the winner honored at FIRA USA 2026.

 What began in 2025 as the Women in AgRobotics of the Year Award now celebrates women driving progress across the full spectrum of agricultural innovation, from robotics and autonomous systems to precision agriculture, data and AI, biotech, digital tools, sensors, software, irrigation and more.

 The shift reflects the evolving reality of modern farming, where hardware, software and data increasingly work together. In a sector still largely dominated by men, the award spotlights founders, engineers, farmers, researchers and leaders whose determination, vision and tangible impact are shaping the future of AgTech.

 “Agricultural innovation is stronger when the women shaping it are visible, heard and connected across borders,” said Maialen Cazenave, the co-director of GOFAR (the Global Organization for Agricultural Robotics) and the FIRA events. “This award is an opportunity to recognize the leaders whose ideas and determination are helping agriculture evolve for the future.”

 Last year’s winner, Arha Padman, chief marketing officer and member of the founder’s office at Niqo Robotics, set a high bar as the inaugural honoree, recognized for her leadership in advancing AI-powered agricultural robotics and for inspiring the next generation of women in the field. The 2026 award builds on that foundation while opening the door wider.

 “One thing I learned working on the front lines of technology is that innovation needs translators. People who can move between the language of technology, the economics of a business and the lived reality of the consumer. That is why I believe this award matters. It is not about celebrating individual achievement, but about making the pathways of AgTech more visible to the women who will shape its next chapter. When you make the people building the future visible, you make it easier for others to believe there is a place for them in it,” said Arha.

 The award is open to all women holding an influential or strategic role in agriculture, robotics or AgTech more broadly. Candidates will be evaluated on professional contributions and achievements, innovation scope, project impact, leadership and role-model qualities, and a short personal statement explaining why they should be honored. A brief video introduction (maximum of two minutes) is also requested.

 Submit applications through the official application form: Apply here.

 A jury of leaders and advocates from agriculture, robotics and AgTech will review entries.

 The winner will receive an official FIRA USA trophy and on-stage recognition at FIRA USA 2026 (Oct. 20–22 in Yakima, Washington), visibility across FIRA USA channels, use of the official award logo, potential media features in Women In Ag Magazine and Agricultural Robotics News, and opportunities for community engagement with partner organizations. Partner prizes include membership and event benefits from American Agri-Women and California Women for Agriculture, with additional prizes possibly added.

 “We encourage everyone across our network to participate in this expanded. By amplifying the achievements and voices of women innovators, the award seeks to inspire more women to enter and lead in the AgTech ecosystem,” said Cazenave.

 For more information about FIRA USA 2026 and the Women in Agricultural Innovation Award, visit FIRA USA.

translationZh:
Arha Padman（右二）来自Niqo Robotics，是2025年首届农业机器人女性年度奖的获得者，在FIRA USA 2025的舞台上接受表彰。该奖项现已扩展并更名为农业创新女性奖，旨在表彰通过AgTech推动农业未来发展的女性。

第二届农业创新女性奖（WiAI）现已开放提名，FIRA USA扩大了其对农业创新领域女性领导者的认可范围。申请截止日期为10月5日，获奖者将在FIRA USA 2026上接受表彰。

该奖项始于2025年的农业机器人女性年度奖，如今旨在表彰在农业创新全谱系中推动进步的女性，涵盖机器人技术与自主系统、精准农业、数据与AI、生物技术、数字工具、传感器、软件、灌溉等领域。

这一转变反映了现代 farming 不断演变的现实——硬件、软件和数据日益协同工作。在一个仍主要由男性主导的行业中，该奖项聚焦于创始人、工程师、农民、研究人员和领导者，她们的决心、远见和切实影响正在塑造AgTech的未来。

“当塑造农业创新的女性被看见、被倾听并在跨国界连接时，农业创新会更加强大，”GOFAR（全球农业机器人组织）和FIRA活动的联合总监Maialen Cazenave表示。“这个奖项是一个机会，用来认可那些思想和决心正在帮助农业为未来演进的领导者。”

去年的获奖者Arha Padman是Niqo Robotics的首席营销官兼创始人办公室成员，作为首届获奖者树立了高标准，她因在推进AI驱动的农业机器人方面的领导力以及激励下一代女性进入该领域而受到认可。2026年的奖项在此基础上更进一步，同时打开了更广阔的大门。

“在技术前沿工作让我学到的一件事是，创新需要翻译者。这些人能够在技术语言、商业经济学和消费者的生活现实之间穿梭。这就是为什么我相信这个奖项很重要。它不是要庆祝个人成就，而是要让AgTech的道路对将塑造其下一篇章的女性更加可见。当你让建设未来的人变得可见时，你就让其他人更容易相信其中也有她们的位置，”Arha说道。

该奖项面向所有在农业、机器人或更广泛的AgTech领域担任有影响力或战略性角色的女性。候选人将根据专业贡献和成就、创新范围、项目影响、领导力和榜样品质，以及一份解释为何应获此殊荣的简短个人陈述进行评估。还需提交一段简短的视频介绍（最长两分钟）。

通过官方申请表提交申请：在此申请。

由农业、机器人技术和AgTech领域的领导者和倡导者组成的评审团将审查参赛作品。

获奖者将获得官方FIRA USA奖杯，并在FIRA USA 2026（10月20-22日，华盛顿州亚基马）的舞台上接受表彰，还将在FIRA USA各渠道获得曝光、使用官方奖项标志、有机会在《Women In Ag Magazine》和《Agricultural Robotics News》上获得媒体报道，以及与合作伙伴组织进行社区互动的机会。合作伙伴奖品包括美国农业女性和加州农业女性提供的会员资格和活动福利，可能还会增加更多奖品。

“我们鼓励我们网络中的每个人参与这个扩展后的奖项。通过放大女性创新者的成就和声音，该奖项旨在激励更多女性进入并引领AgTech生态系统，”Cazenave说道。

有关FIRA USA 2026和农业创新女性奖的更多信息，请访问FIRA USA。
